description: Messinaservizi Bene Comune S.p.A. publishes destination facilities for municipal waste collected within Messina, Italy. The metadata associates facilities with waste types using CER codes. Listed resources include a PDF and georeferenced CSV for 2021, a georeferenced CSV for March 2022, and an XLSX resource labelled June 2022. These facilities and waste-type associations can supply location and compatibility inputs for waste-service capacity planning. The metadata does not establish processing capacity, waste quantities, travel times or a current operating status. The stated service territory is Messina; destination facilities are not necessarily located inside the municipal boundary. Creative Commons Attribution is listed without a version, while cost and download conditions remain unverified. The public metadata API returned the exact identifier and title.
